items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: That's George Washington. You may never have known him. ... No, I never knew him.

ctx.x: Alright, well we all know now.

Okay Sadie, what's today's date? Today is December, it's 11th, 1984. 1984, okay. Let me see now. I had a photograph I wanted to show you. You know any of those guys? I'm pretty. I played with his band. Yeah, do you know the drummer here? That's Chani? No, that's not Chani and him. That's Faso. Faso, uh. I don't know if you ever knew Faso. I don't think I knew him, no. That's George Washington. You may never have known him. He's from Uptown. No, I never knew him. That fella with the cap on and the cornet, you knew…
Okay. I think we should check and make sure that we are getting this okay before we go further, don't we?
